descripcion: I lead the evolution of the corporate Design System, establishing the single source of truth for product, design, and engineering across a multi-country operation. I architected the tokenization strategy, publishing the second NPM package with 37 tokenized components ready for development use. I resolved component inconsistency in production by establishing a common, governed, and semantically versioned library.

I was involved end-to-end — discovery, ideation, design, handoff, and evolution. I raised adoption to 95% among Directors and 39% among Consultants, surpassing the previous version (80% and 25–32% respectively) at the corporate level. I translated research findings into detailed specifications for development, ensuring alignment with the business's strategic goals.

I led user research and wireframe design, carrying the design process from conceptualization through low- and high-fidelity prototyping. I conducted usability testing, working closely with UI designers and developers to ensure design solutions were functional and aligned with user needs and project goals.

I designed web and mobile interfaces, graphic assets, and template adaptations for Profuturo, Brapex, and Funciton. Created high-fidelity prototypes in Adobe XD and Principle. Designed presentations and visual assets.

I designed creative assets for indoor advertising sales, ensuring each piece met the quality and appeal standards needed to capture the target audience's attention. I also handled the review and production of videos and animations for digital ads, optimizing visual content for each location.
Designed content for websites, social media, and every brand touchpoint for the agency's clients, bringing a structured creative process to each deliverable.
